units.source_text: “如果这女子还在世间，一定潦倒不堪了吧！

en.t: If that woman were still in this world, she must surely be living in wretched poverty by now!

units.source_text: 以前如果她知道我爱她，因而常常向我申恨诉怨，表示些缠绵悱恻的神色，那么也不至于弃家飘泊吧。

en.t: If she had known then that I loved her, and had often shown me her resentment and sorrow with some tender, heartbroken look, she would probably not have abandoned her home and wandered away.

units.source_text: 那时我对她就不会长久绝迹，我一定把她看作一个难分难舍的妻子，永远爱护她了。

en.t: In that case I would not have stayed away from her for so long; I would surely have regarded her as a wife I could not part from, and cherished her forever.

units.source_text: 那孩子很可爱，我设法寻找，但至今杳无音信。

en.t: That child was very dear, and I tried to search for him, but to this day there has been no news at all.

units.source_text: 这和刚才左马头所说的不可信赖的女子，同此一例。

en.t: This is the same kind of case as the unreliable woman whom the Captain of the Left Division of the Palace Guards mentioned just now.

units.source_text: 这女子表面不动声色，而心中恨我薄情。

en.t: Outwardly this woman showed no sign of feeling, but in her heart she resented my coldness.

units.source_text: 我却一向不知，只觉此人可怜，这也是一种徒劳的单相思吧。

en.t: I, however, never knew it and only pitied her; perhaps that too was a kind of futile one-sided love.

units.source_text: 现在我已渐渐忘怀，但她恐怕还是惦记我，更深人静之夜，不免抚胸悲叹吧。

en.t: By now I have gradually forgotten her, but she is probably still thinking of me, and on deep, silent nights she must press her hand to her breast and sigh with grief.

units.source_text: 这是一个不能偕老、不可信赖的女子。

en.t: She is a woman with whom one cannot grow old together, and on whom one cannot rely.

units.source_text: 这样看来，刚才说的那个爱嫉妒的女子，回想她尽心服侍的好处，也觉得难于忘怀，

en.t: Seen in this light, even the jealous woman mentioned just now seems hard to forget when one remembers how devotedly she served.

units.source_text: 但倘和她对面共处，则又觉得噜苏可厌，甚至可以决绝的了。

en.t: But if one lived face to face with her, she would again seem tiresome and hateful, enough that one might even break with her completely.

units.source_text: 又如，即使是长于弹琴、聪明伶俐的才女，但其轻狂浮薄是罪不容恕的。

en.t: Or again, even a talented woman who is skilled at the koto and bright and clever cannot be forgiven for frivolity and shallowness.

units.source_text: 刚才我所说的那个女子，其不露声色，也会令人怀疑。

en.t: As for the woman I spoke of just now, the very fact that she showed nothing on the surface also makes one suspicious.

units.source_text: 究竟如何是好，终于不能决定。

en.t: In the end, one cannot decide what is really best.

units.source_text: 人世之事，大都如此吧。

en.t: Most things in this world are probably like this.

units.source_text: 像我们这样举出一个一个的人儿来，互相比较，也不容易决定其优劣。

en.t: Even when we bring up one person after another like this and compare them with each other, it is not easy to decide who is better or worse.

units.source_text: 具足各种优点而全无半点缺陷的女子，哪里找得到呢？

en.t: Where could one ever find a woman who possesses every virtue and not the slightest flaw?

units.source_text: 那么只有向吉祥天女[\[16\]](#part1331.html#m16)求爱，

en.t: Then one would have no choice but to seek love from Kisshoten, the goddess of good fortune[\[16\]](#part1331.html#m16),

units.source_text: 然而佛法气味太重，教人害怕，毕竟是亲近不得的啊！”

en.t: but she has too strong an air of Buddhism about her, which makes one afraid, and in the end she cannot be approached at all!"

units.source_text: 说得大家都笑起来。

en.t: At this, everyone burst out laughing.
